_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
No migration, no change to your data. Card images now load in their original size instead of being scaled down by the server. On a phone this uses noticeably more data, and images from card databases as well as placeholders are now fetched by your browser directly from their image servers (until now the PokéCollect server fetched them). An image address you entered by hand that points to another site is now shown; until now it stayed empty.

• Security: image optimization is switched off for now. Two critical flaws became known in the image service of the frontend framework (Next.js) that could let an attacker on the network run code on the server without logging in. They are only fixed in a newer major version of the framework; the move to it follows. Until then the image service is off — the affected endpoint is switched off, and images come straight from their source.
title: Security hotfix: image optimization switched off
